tools.name: verify_key
tools.description: Confirm SHELF_SMOKE_API_KEY or Authorization: Bearer (GET /keys/verify). X-API-Key is an alias only. Does not echo the secret.

tools.name: list_credit_packs
tools.description: Prepaid TEST packs (GET /credits/packs). Buy with checkout_credits then confirm_credits.

tools.name: checkout_credits
tools.description: Stripe TEST PaymentIntent for a pack (POST /credits/checkout). Requires a caller key. Confirm with confirm_credits.

tools.name: confirm_credits
tools.description: Confirm a TEST PaymentIntent with Stripe test card pm_card_visa (POST /credits/confirm). Appends credit.purchase. TEST only.

tools.name: quote_credits
tools.description: Dry-run cost for an op without debit (GET /credits/quote?op=smoke). Returns cost, balance, and would_succeed.

tools.name: credit_balance
tools.description: Derived prepaid balance for this caller_id (GET /credits/balance).

tools.name: credit_events
tools.description: Append-only Ledger events for this caller_id (GET /credits/events): credit.grant (first_key), credit.purchase, credit.debit, optional credit.balance_snapshot.

tools.name: smoke
tools.description: Headless smoke (POST /smoke). Install via GET https://shelf.kymac.co/llms.txt only. Prefer Authorization: Bearer; X-API-Key is an alias. Golden URL https://example.com/ — compare ok true/false JSON in llms.txt. First key includes 1 free credit. Quote first with quote_credits (no debit). Debits 1 cre

tools.name: health
tools.description: Public readiness (GET /health): billing (test|live|gated) and runner_ready. No key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: issue_key, smoke · Private data: issue_key, verify_key · Public sink: issue_key, checkout_credits, confirm_credits, smoke · Destructive: quote_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: issue_key, smoke · Private data: issue_key, verify_key · Public sink: issue_key, checkout_credits, confirm_credits, smoke · Destructive: quote_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
